zh: 把每个人的三个值排序为 a<b<c。要赢两回合，最有利的安排是拿自己最大的两个值去对付对方最小的两个值。
于是 X 能击败 Y 当且仅当 X 的 b 大于 Y 的 a 且 X 的 c 大于 Y 的 b。要击败所有其他人，只需和所有人的 a 的最大值、b 的最大值比较；把自己也算进去不影响，因为自己的 b>a、c>b 天然成立。
读入每行三个数并排序，同时求出所有行 a 的最大值 maxA 和 b 的最大值 maxB；再统计满足 b>maxA 且 c>maxB 的行数并输出。
en: Sort each player's three values as a < b < c. To win two rounds, the best arrangement is to put your two largest values against the opponent's two smallest.

So X beats Y exactly when X's b is greater than Y's a and X's c is greater than Y's b. To beat everyone else, compare against the maximum a and the maximum b over all players; including yourself does not matter, because your own b > a and c > b always hold.
Read each row of three values and sort it, tracking maxA, the largest a over all rows, and maxB, the largest b; then count the rows with b > maxA and c > maxB and print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort each player's values as a < b < c; a player can beat another if their own b is greater than the other's a and their own c is greater than the other's b. So precompute the maximum of all a and of all b, then filter.

## Correctness

To win two rounds, the most favorable plan is to match your two largest values against the opponent's two smallest; the sorted greedy condition is exactly bX > aY and cX > bY, and no other pairing can relax it. To beat every opponent, take the maximum of the opponents' thresholds. Including your own thresholds changes nothing, because your own b > a and c > b hold automatically.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
